id: title:cat-ph:display stack frames most recent call first on every platform

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the visual presentation of stack traces in Error Display and Exception List components by reordering frames to show crash sites first, while preserving pre-normalization crash-first events.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement. P1.F5.H1 provides the complete implementation of the frame reordering utility and its associated tests, establishing the core behavior. P1.F2.H1, P1.F3.H1, P1.F6.H4, P1.F7.H1, and P1.F8.H1 show the necessary integration and property propagation. While P1.F6, P1.F7, and P1.F8 do not show the display-side re-exec,
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on P1.F5.H1 containing the complete implementation and tests; P1.F6, P1.F7, and P1.F8 establish the property and prop changes but do not demonstrate the final display behavior, relying on P1.F5 for the actual reordering logic.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No other PRs are shown, so no unrelated-PR uncertainty exists. No score is assigned; this chunk is not scored.

observations.behavior: Adds a new shared utility module, displayOrder.ts, with toDisplayOrderFrames and isStoredCrashFirst, and a corresponding unit test.
observations.posthog_connection: Reorders stack frames from canonical bottom-up wire order to display order (crash site first) while preserving pre-normalization crash-first events; this could change the visual presentation of stack traces in the Error Display and Exception List components.

observations.behavior: Updates ErrorDisplay.tsx to accept an optional eventTimestamp and pass it to BindLogic.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the timestamp needed by displayOrder.ts to distinguish pre-normalization events; this could support the transient exception handling for events before the wire-order normalization date.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for toDisplayOrderFrames in CollapsibleExceptionList.tsx.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the reordering utility available to the component that renders the exception list, enabling the display-order change.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the referenced dependency `toDisplayOrderFrames` or the definition of the `storedCrashFirst` behavior, so the tier cannot be established. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new property `framesStoredCrashFirst` to the error properties logic, which is passed downstream to stacktrace display and exception card components.
observations.posthog_connection: This property is used to preserve the canonical storage order of frames, but the implementation of this ordering is not supplied in this chunk.

observations.behavior: Passes the event timestamp to the ErrorDisplay component, while the timestamp is not currently used in the display.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds timestamp to the display props, but the chunk does not show how this timestamp is used to change the display behavior.
